title: 2-Hour Private Pink Bachelorette Boat Cruise in San Diego Bay
includes: Cooler with ice and bottled water
Banner set up for the special occasion
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
With a Captain at the helm, you and your friends will enjoy a 2 hours Harbor Tour for up to 8 guests on the amazing Pink Boat in San Diego Bay. Our "Pink Panther" and "Flamingo" are new electric Duffy 2023 boats.

Enjoy the view of Downtown San Diego, Coronado Island, and Bridge, Maritime, and Midway museums on the Barbie boat cruise. Best of all, you can bring your drinks on board! Whether you want to toast to the bride-to-be or enjoy a fun day with the girls. And the last one: Everything is better in Pink!

The Pink Boat Harbor tour is a fantastic way to:
- celebrate a Birthday party on the water
- surprise the Bride with the best Bachelorette party idea
- comfortable family cruise with kids
- Barbie theme teenager Birthday celebration
